newsitem.title: USA: Porsche looks to double US sales in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Porsche looks to double US sales in 1997.

text.p: Porsche AG said Tuesday it expects the introduction of its Boxster sportscar to help it double its sales in the United States in 1997.

The company is confident the introduction of the car "will double our 1996 U.S. sales this year to approximately 14,000," Fred Schwab, Porsche Cars North America Inc president, told reporters at the North American International Auto Show.
With a manufacturer-suggested retail price of $39,980, the two-seat Boxster is priced below the Porsche 911.
It includes a 2.5 liter 201 horse power engine and can go from zero to 62 miles an hour in 6.9 seconds, Schwab said, adding that the car has a top track speed of 149 miles per hour.
